# Molla Afzal — Digital Marketing & SEO Portfolio

> Portfolio of Molla Afzal, a digital marketing professional focused on SEO, content strategy, social media marketing and local SEO.

Canonical website: https://mollaafzal.netlify.app/

## Main pages
- [Homepage and portfolio](https://mollaafzal.netlify.app/): Professional profile, selected work, SEO performance highlights, skills and contact links.
- [Digital marketing services](https://mollaafzal.netlify.app/services/): Overview of the services offered.

## Services
- [SEO & Organic Growth](https://mollaafzal.netlify.app/services/seo-organic-growth/): Keyword research, on-page SEO, internal linking, technical SEO reviews and organic performance reporting.
- [Content Strategy & Writing](https://mollaafzal.netlify.app/services/content-strategy-writing/): Content planning, SEO blog writing, content briefs and website copy.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://mollaafzal.netlify.app/services/social-media-marketing/): Content calendars, campaign concepts and brand-aligned communication.
- [Local SEO & Google Business Profile](https://mollaafzal.netlify.app/services/local-seo-google-business-profile/): Local keyword research, profile recommendations, location-page improvements and reporting.
